name: Rank-Augmented Linear Attention Compressor (RALA Compressor) – Production-H
description: Rank-Augmented Linear Attention Compressor (RALA Compressor) – Production-Hardened. Maps to and aliases framework.attentions.rala_attention.RALALinearAttention.
math_latex: S_{\text{KV}} = \sum_{j=1}^N \phi(K_j) V_j^T \in \mathbb{R}^{B \times H \times d \times d}, \quad z = \sum_{j=1}^N \phi(K_j) \in \mathbb{R}^{B \times H \times d}

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
